item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture-foundation
summary:      Establish the Python application structure and module boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     application module structure
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python application structure and document module ownership and boundaries for configuration, persistence, CLI, and HTTP service code.

## story database-foundation
summary:      Declare the rates store and its repository operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and every repository operation needed by the loader and API. Store published rates as text and use a unique date and currency key.

## story cli-foundation
summary:      Establish the fxrates command-line entry point.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Foundation.md
stack:        cli.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     ./fxrates entry point
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the root executable and CLI package using the published CLI foundation contract. Support dispatch to the planned commands and their declared exit-code conventions.

## story api-foundation
summary:      Establish the FastAPI application and local server entry point.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Foundation.md
stack:        fastapi.md
depends:      architecture-foundation, database-foundation
provides:     FastAPI application factory, uvicorn server entry point
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the FastAPI application factory and uvicorn entry point on 127.0.0.1. Configure the application to use the declared persistence boundary and database location.

## story ecb-001
summary:      Initialize the rates store from the command line.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Store-Initialization.md
covers:       ECB-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database-foundation, cli-foundation
provides:     fxrates init
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement fxrates init to drop and recreate an empty rates table. Follow the declared database configuration precedence and command exit-code contract.

## story ecb-002
summary:      Validate and load ECB history files atomically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ECB-Loading.md
covers:       ECB-002
accepts:      st-003, st-008
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database-foundation, cli-foundation, ecb-001
provides:     fxrates load
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement complete-file CSV validation before writes, non-N/A rate storage as published text, replacement by date and currency, and the declared load summary. Reject invalid files atomically with exit code 3; use exit code 1 for operational file errors.

## story ecb-003
summary:      Fetch and load the ECB history archive.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ECB-Fetch.md
covers:       ECB-003
accepts:      st-009
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        cli.md, python.md
depends:      ecb-002
provides:     fxrates fetch
consumes:     fxrates load
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement archive download and extraction, then delegate loading and summary behavior to the load workflow. Report download failures with the declared operational exit code. Tests must replace the downloader with a stub and must not use the network.

## story api-001
summary:      Serve health, dataset statistics, and available currencies.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Dataset-Summary.md
covers:       API-001
accepts:      st-004
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      api-foundation, database-foundation
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats, GET /currencies
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the health, dataset summary, and sorted currency endpoints using values queried from the database.

## story api-002
summary:      Retrieve rates for an effective publication date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Effective-Rates.md
covers:       API-002
accepts:      st-005, st-007
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      api-foundation, database-foundation
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement date and latest rate lookups using the latest publication on or before the requested date. Return 404 when no effective publication exists and 422 for malformed dates.

## story api-003
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies using exact decimal arithmetic.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Currency-Conversion.md
covers:       API-003
accepts:      st-005, st-006, st-007
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      api-foundation, database-foundation
provides:     GET /convert
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement conversion using exact decimal arithmetic and half-even rounding. Compute the result from unrounded stored rates, use the latest publication when date is omitted, and return the declared 404 and 422 statuses for invalid conditions.

## story api-004
summary:      Retrieve currency history and exact summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Currency-History.md
covers:       API-004
accepts:      st-006, st-007
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      api-foundation, database-foundation
provides:     GET /history/{code}
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement ascending history points with optional inclusive date bounds, stored-text minimum and maximum values, and the exact half-even six-decimal mean. Return the specified empty result and error statuses.

## story del-001
summary:      Provide the automated pytest suite and POSIX test runner.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Test-Runner.md
covers:       DEL-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     bin/test.sh, pytest suite
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that runs the project's pytest suite from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes. The suite must cover commands, loading rules, endpoints, effective dates, rounding, and error statuses using a real temporary database, with fetch stubbed.

## story del-002
summary:      Verify the completed application against the supplied grader.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Grader-Conformance.md
covers:       DEL-002
accepts:      st-001
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
depends:      architecture-foundation, database-foundation, cli-foundation, api-foundation, ecb-001, ecb-002, ecb-003, api-001, api-002, api-003, api-004, del-001
provides:     supplied grader conformance
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  As the terminal story, run the complete supplied sources/run.sh suite and require success. Do not run the whole grader in earlier stories.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
